DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
        WHERE execution_mode = 'canonical'
           OR canonical_message_command_id IS NOT NULL
           OR canonical_student_message_id IS NOT NULL
           OR status = 'materialized'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove canonical onboarding receipts after use';
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uq_teacher_onboarding_canonical_source_action;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_execution_mode_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_status_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_result_status_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_claim_pair_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_expected_pair_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_mode_columns_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_shape_ck,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_onboarding_terminal_claim_ck;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
    DROP COLUMN canonical_student_message_id,
    DROP COLUMN canonical_message_command_id,
    DROP COLUMN execution_mode;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_status_ck
        CHECK (status IN ('claimed', 'applied', 'completed', 'rejected')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_result_status_ck
        CHECK (result_status IN ('DRAFT', 'COMPLETED')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_claim_pair_ck
        CHECK ((claim_token IS NULL) = (locked_until IS NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_expected_pair_ck
        CHECK ((expected_draft_version IS NULL) = (expected_profile_version IS NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_shape_ck
        CHECK ((status IN ('claimed','rejected') AND result_draft_version IS NULL AND result_profile_version IS NULL AND result_status IS NULL AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
            OR (status = 'applied' AND result_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND result_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND result_status IS NOT NULL AND next_message_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
            OR (status = 'completed' AND result_draft_version IS NOT NULL AND result_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND result_status IS NOT NULL AND next_message_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_terminal_claim_ck
        CHECK (status IN ('claimed','applied') OR (claim_token IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL));
